verdict.rationale: Rive exposes agent-facing surfaces (MCP server, CLI, RML), so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question here. However, the evidence documents no sandbox, staging, or test mode that isolates agent actions from production files or data. Revision history makes restores non-destructive, but that is a rollback and versioning feature, not sandbox isolation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
